title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: FLAC -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Dolby B) -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy Boston Garden show with a smoking Samson & Delilah and a soaring encore.
ai_review.review: The upgraded SBD mix is praised for its clarity and ability to convey the crowd’s excitement, delivering a solid first set followed by a second set that “smokes” with high energy. Standout moments include a powerful Phil bomb on "Samson & Delijah" and an uplifting encore of "It’s All Over Now Baby Blue," while the only noticeable slip is a brief flub in "Truckin’."

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (5,5,4) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and soundboard quality outweigh a few neutral/negative notes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers highlight crisp, clear mix and an overall upgrade to previous releases; no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: It's All Over Now Baby Blue
show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set, followed by a high‑energy second set that builds momentum and ends with an uplifting encore; the band feeds off the crowd throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Powerful Phil bomb at the start of "Samson & Delilah" noted by reviewers.
